organization.short_description:
Cohere is a Canadian multinational artificial intelligence company founded in 2019, specializing in foundational large language models (LLMs) and enterprise AI solutions for regulated industries. Headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, with offices in major cities worldwide, Cohere focuses on deploying AI in finance, healthcare, manufacturing, energy, and the public sector, prioritizing security and data privacy.

The company offers an all-in-one platform that provides developers and enterprises access to advanced natural language processing tools through API, private cloud, or on-premises infrastructure. Its product suite includes generative models for content generation, retrieval models for advanced search, and AI-powered workplace systems to enhance enterprise workflows. Cohere's models are designed for secure, customizable deployments, allowing organizations to fine-tune them on internal data.

Cohere targets business customers and enterprise clients, emphasizing data sovereignty and appealing to non-US markets. The company is backed by notable investors, including Nvidia and Oracle, and offers flexible deployment options to meet the needs of organizations with strict regulatory requirements.
